1. (Currently amended) An Internet system that supports a search service, the Internet system comprising: a search server that is adapted to receive search criteria from a client device remote from the search server; a historical data repository coupled to the search server, wherein the historical data repository contains historical data collected from over the Internet, and wherein the search server stores data retrieved from over the Internet and eventually stores the data as historical data within the historical data repository when the data is no longer preserved in the search server; and wherein the search server receives the search criteria to search for older historical data that was in existence on the Internet at a previous time, wherein the search server obtains search results to satisfy the search criteria by searching the historical data stored in the historical data repository, and wherein the search server is configured to exclude certain types of data from being stored as historical data.

2. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is date tagged so that the historical data is associated with a date representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet, and wherein the historical data repository is configured to manage the storage of historical data based on user-defined parameters.

3. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 2 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is time tagged so that the historical data is associated with a time representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet, and wherein the time tagging is performed in accordance with a user-specified time format.

4. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data placed within the historical data repository is time tagged so that the historical data is associated with a time representative of when the historical data was available on the Internet, and wherein the time tagging is performed in accordance with a user-specified time format.

5. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the search server contains a cache memory that temporarily stores the data retrieved from over the Internet and eventually transfers the data to an archival database module that manages historical content within the search server and eventually moves historical content on the search server to the historical data repository to support historical searching, and wherein the archival database module is configured to prioritize data based on user preferences.

6. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data repository comprises: central processing circuitry; communication circuitry coupled to the central processing circuitry for communicating data in to and out from the historical data repository; and local storage coupled to the central processing circuitry that contains an index storage module for storing historical data according to indices and a time based sorting module for storing historical data according to date and time, and wherein the local storage is configured to allow dynamic updates based on user interactions.

7. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein certain data is removed from the historical data before it is placed for long-term storage within the historical data repository, and wherein the removal process is based on user-defined criteria.

8. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 7 wherein the certain data that is removed from the historical data comprises one type of data selected from the group consisting of: advertisements, illegal content, and non-value added content, and wherein the selection criteria for removal is customizable by the user.

9. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the search server can search historical data along with browser activity based data associated with a user and favorites data associated with the user, and wherein the search server is configured to integrate results from both historical and current data sources.

10. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the search server is coupled to a web crawler that periodically crawls the internet to retrieve Internet content from predetermined Internet locations, and wherein the search server time/date stamps that Internet content and places that Internet content in the historical data repository for later time/date historical searching by a user, and wherein the web crawler is configured to adapt its crawling strategy based on user-defined parameters.

11. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 10 wherein the web crawler comprises: a URL server for storing URLs that are to be periodically crawled; a scheduler module for scheduling and starting web crawling operations using the web crawler; a URL crawling module for crawling the predetermined Internet locations for the Internet content; and a content change detection module for determining if the Internet content is different from the content stored previously in the historical data repository and storing new Internet data in the historical data repository as a part of the historical data, and wherein the content change detection module is configured to allow user-defined thresholds for change detection.

12. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein the historical data contains sub-links that connect to other data and wherein the system also historically archives the other data within the sub-links for historical preservation and historical searching by a user, and wherein the archiving process is based on user-defined criteria.

13. (Currently amended) The Internet system of claim 1 wherein a content change detection module determines if data retrieved from over the Internet is different from the content stored previously in the historical data repository and stores only those portions that are different from historical data already stored within the historical data repository as a part of the historical data, and wherein the content change detection module is configurable based on user preferences.

20. (Currently amended) A network browser in a computer for browsing websites, the network browser comprising: a search criteria window that prompts a user to enter search terms and timeline information; a first module that enables a search of the Internet to determine search results that existed within a time frame delineated by the timeline information, and wherein the search results correlate to the search terms, and wherein the first module is configured to allow user-defined time parameters for historical searches; and a second module that receives the search results from over the Internet.
